steps.what: Select current business sources and the conceptual sequence for the lecture
Prepare lecture explanations and worked business examples from the verified brief

loop.input: Verified brief, source excerpts and teacher-selected concepts
loop.output: Draft lecture notes with cited source passages and explicit calculations
loop.check: Teacher verifies conceptual accuracy, assumptions, arithmetic and suitability for the class
loop.stop: Unsupported claims or incorrect calculations return to manual preparation after two drafts
loop.why_not_simpler: Explaining business concepts requires contextual prose beyond inserting fixed fields

steps.what: Deliver lectures and respond to undergraduate or graduate students' questions

tasks.design: Reuse native lecture templates in {DOCS} before adding a bounded drafting loop. The teacher chooses sources and checks every explanation and calculation, then delivers the lecture through the normal class and {LMS} materials.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparing clear explanations and examples takes wording effort beyond selecting the content.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can assist source-based explanation without changing live teaching.
tasks.still_hard: Current accounting assumptions, misleading examples and questions outside the planned scope.
tasks.human_edge: Connecting business theory with students' misconceptions and experience.
tasks.altitude: Possible reduction in lecture-note drafting; contact time and subject decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Source-constrained business lecture drafting is a model-knowledge design; the digest has no measured lecture-preparation saving for this occupation.

assumptions: Boundary includes lecture-specific source selection, notes and delivery. Syllabi and reusable homework or handouts belong to the course-material task; reused assets earn saving only once.
Teacher produces topic, level, selected sources, intended concepts, assumptions and example requirements in s1; all20 hours include capture. Missing evidence is researched manually, not generated.
Draft review and corrections are within retained s2 time. Native templates are tested before a model; no new live teaching automation.
No student personal data is needed for drafting.
unknowns: Permitted source reuse and drafting environment
research_questions: Does verifying worked examples retain at least half of the proposed wording benefit?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R85 gives gross15 minus upkeep3 = net12. Low assumes only3 hours benefit after calculation checking; high requires50% reduction of the30-hour drafting step. Source selection and lecture delivery remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Evaluate students' class work, assignments and papers against the rubric
Write feedback explaining strengths, errors and improvements in the evaluated work

loop.purpose: Draft feedback wording from instructor findings
loop.input: Rubric, teacher findings and referenced submission passages
loop.output: Draft feedback tied to the instructor's evaluation
loop.check: Teacher checks every criticism, calculation reference and proposed improvement against the submission
loop.stop: Unsupported assessment or changed meaning returns to manual feedback after two drafts
loop.why_not_simpler: Individual explanatory feedback needs contextual prose; final evaluation is already human

steps.what: Decide final grades and release checked feedback for each submission

tasks.design: Configure native rubric and feedback templates in {LMS}. Use a bounded loop only to draft feedback from the teacher's findings; the teacher evaluates the full submission and decides and releases its grade.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feedback wording adds repeated prose work after evaluating the student's reasoning.
tasks.enabler_now: Instructor-note-based feedback drafting is available, without establishing automated grading validity.
tasks.still_hard: Novel arguments and errors that look plausible without checking their assumptions.
tasks.human_edge: Fair evaluation of reasoning and useful, proportionate feedback.
tasks.altitude: Less feedback wording may be possible; examiner authority remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: D2L Brightspace Lumi Feedback drafts text and rubric feedback from instructor notes.
The Michigan economics study reported improved revisions but provided no time data; it does not establish the proposed saving.
The feedback-wording saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is coursework evaluation and feedback, not compiling examinations or maintaining duplicate result registers.
Business teacher produces criterion findings, quoted examples, provisional marks and uncertainties in s1; all60 hours include capture. There is no free rubric assessment or model-created finding.
Missing teacher observations return to manual feedback within s2. Native templates precede a loop and no model sets marks.
Institutional permissions and assessment policy are confirmed before student work is processed.
unknowns: Institutional processing restrictions and assessment rules
research_questions: Does complete feedback checking save net time without adding unsupported criticism?

approvals.approved_version: Exact grade and corrected feedback for the identified submission; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90 gives gross10 minus upkeep3 = net7. Low assumes checking removes all wording benefit; high needs40% reduction of the25-hour feedback-writing step while evaluation and release remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Initiate, facilitate and moderate classroom discussions of business ideas and cases

tasks.design: Retain classroom facilitation with the teacher. Case readings in {LMS} support the discussion but do not replace listening, challenge or student participation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful interventions depend on the arguments students actually make.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing case access supports the conversation without removing moderation.
tasks.still_hard: Encouraging participation and exposing weak assumptions without closing debate.
tasks.human_edge: Asking a timely question and making room for competing interpretations.
tasks.altitude: No change to classroom time or facilitation responsibility.

evidence.claim: Live classroom moderation remains unchanged; no labour saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is live discussion, not case-writing or assessing participation. Discussion time is assigned once if embedded in a lecture.
No transcript or structured student-participation score is introduced.
Native material access is enough; no custom build.
Zero upkeep because the existing facilitation process continues.
research_questions: Which discussion practices help students examine assumptions more clearly?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives net0 after zero upkeep; no preparation baseline or shorter discussion is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select course requirements, sources and assignment goals for syllabi and handouts
Prepare syllabi, homework assignments and handouts from the verified material brief

loop.purpose: Draft material text within the teacher's course brief
loop.input: Outcomes, timetable, verified sources and assignment requirements
loop.output: Draft materials with source references and explicit exercise solutions
loop.check: Teacher checks goal coverage, solvability, calculations, workload and source fidelity
loop.stop: Unsupported sources or unsound exercises return to manual writing after two drafts
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates fill fixed fields but cannot write coherent individual exercises and explanations

steps.what: Check course materials and approve the exact version for student use

tasks.design: Use approved {DOCS} templates for fixed course fields before adding a bounded drafting loop. The teacher selects sources and goals, checks every exercise and explanation, then approves the exact materials for {LMS} use.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reusable documents still need course-specific wording and exercises.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-constrained text drafting can reduce initial composition effort.
tasks.still_hard: Valid exercises, current assumptions and an appropriate student workload.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing worthwhile problems and judging their learning value.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft composition; course design and release decisions stay human.

evidence.claim: Business course-material drafting and the time range are model-knowledge proposals; no task-specific measured case is provided by the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is reusable syllabus, homework and handout production. Lecture-specific notes belong to the lecture task; reused sources or drafting effort must be assigned once in roll-ups.

Teacher produces course dates, outcomes, source selections, exercise constraints and intended workload in s1; all30 hours include capture. Missing details require teacher clarification before drafting.
Native templates are tested first; fixed date insertion earns no separate model claim. Manual correction remains within s2 and final checks retain all s3 time.
No student records or confidential third-party research are required as drafting inputs.
research_questions: Do exercise verification and accessibility checks leave a net composition benefit?

approvals.approved_version: Exact corrected syllabus, homework or handout version and its course context; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R77.5 gives gross22.5 minus upkeep4 = net18.5. Low assumes exercise corrections leave only4 hours drafting benefit; high requires half the45-hour composition step removed, with source selection and final approval unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Business teachers keep teaching and assessment authority while testing bounded help with composition.
reach: Work with instructional designers on examples and assessment coordinators on rubric interpretation
role.ambitious_version: Clear business teaching materials and precise feedback, with actual net benefits measured separately from live instruction.
